posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
In a game against Dawn, she played Summer and someone else on her turn. I rewound back to the environment turn for some reason, probably because I'd changed my mind about what card to discard or something, and didn't have the opportunity to correct before the villain turn started. When Dawn played cards again she pulled out Truth and the same other guy, rather than Summer and that guy. I specifically remember planning to Final Dive Summer on Fanatic's turn, so I was double unhappy to see Truth!

I tried in a few other non-Dawn games just to see if that card-changing happened again but it didn't. I suspect that the villain card play is fixed once it's been "decided" but Summer/Truth came into play via Return with the Dawn and that shuffles just before revealing and therefore can yield a different Citizen if you replay the turn.

It does make me think though, isn't it horribly cheaty to be able to rewind all the hero turns once you know what the villain/environment's going to do? Or horribly cheaty if you can potentially avoid the worst Citizens?

How about an "are you sure you're happy with the round, no rewinds if you click yes" confirmation after the hero turns?

Humble-Knight:

I noticed one problem too. I used rapid recon and it reshuffled my deck. If it was the last card in my deck, the deck wouldn't reshuffle til the next turn, if there were no cards left nothing should have been revealed

We can look into this, revealing should not cause a reshuffle. Are you sure it happened on rapid recon and not because of the card draw afterward?

If you had no card in your deck and used rapid recon, the power would fizzle and then you draw a card - triggering a reshuffle.
